source.check: every name and label checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1946: 24 nominations received, one invalid; no contests. Returned unopposed. No nomination; the sitting member is deemed to be returned if he accepts office. The label is unclear on the image (it appears to read "Com., Lab.").
